title: ngen-2010-world-heavyweight
label: Shawn Hart

won.source: Won the vacant title from Felix Red, the WFW World Heavyweight Champion, in the main event of Cherry Blossom Chaos, as its founder tells it in his post of 12 January 2011.

how: Beat Felix Red, the WFW World Heavyweight Champion, to become the first NGEN World Heavyweight Champion; his post of 12 January 2011 gives the result and no finish.
note: The broadcast part for this match was never posted; the result is his post of 12 January 2011, and the show date is the date of the first part of the broadcast.

won.source: Won the vacant titles from Cameron Cruise and Problem Child, the WFW World Tag Champions, at Cherry Blossom Chaos, as its founder tells it in his post of 12 January 2011.

how: Striker pinned Cameron Cruise after Problem Child screwed Cruise.

label: HAL

won.source: Won the vacant title in the Falls Count Anywhere on the Mall elimination match at Cherry Blossom Chaos, as its founder tells it in his post of 12 January 2011.

how: Pinned Psycho to win the elimination match against Psycho, Just 1 Dude and JGX.

title: ngen-2010-bad-world-heavyweight
label: Jared Wells

won.source: Named the BAD World Heavyweight Champion in the fed's list of its champions of 20 January 2010, which says the title would be kept under its name; the fed's own B.A.D. title history post dates his win over Steve Johnson to 31 December 2009 at Unplugged.

how: Carried the title into NGEN; he kept it against Jesse Ramey at Cherry Blossom Chaos, pinning him when both men were out cold after a Rage Bomb off the top rope.
